name: google-cicd-pipeline-design
description: Use this skill to design and implement a Google Cloud based CI/CD pipeline. This skill encodes best practices for pipeline design, ensuring proper pattern selection and implementation. You MUST activate this skill when tasked with building a pipeline, designing architecture on GCP, or migrating pipelines. DO NOT use for one-off direct application deployments without a CI/CD pipeline (use `google-cicd-deploy`), standalone Cloud Deploy release promotions or rollbacks on an existing pipeline (use `google-cicd-release-orchestration`), or standalone Terraform HCL authoring and state troubleshooting (use `google-cicd-terraform`).
author: google
